description: Relay notifications to Tailscale endpoint when screen is locked

hooks.command: input=$(cat); if ioreg -n Root -d1 | grep -q '"CGSSessionScreenIsLocked" = Yes'; then echo "$input" | jq -r '.message' | curl -s --max-time 5 -X POST "${TAILSCALE_NOTIFY_URL:-https://YOUR-DEVICE.YOUR-TAILNET.ts.net:7080}/$(hostname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -d @-; fi || true
